services.label: Services
services.title: Websites, apps and integrations
services.intro: I can build a site that explains what you do, a tool for your team or a connection between systems you already use. Tell me what you need, and we'll work out the scope together.

items.title: Websites & landing pages
items.text: A clear website that explains your offer and makes it easy for people to contact you or buy from you.
deliverables: Layouts for phone and desktop, with animation where useful
Page structure and basic SEO setup

items.title: Web applications & tools
items.text: A web app for customers or an internal tool that helps your team get work done.

items.title: Integrations & automation
items.text: Connect the tools you use and automate tasks your team repeats every day.

items.title: Make good products better
items.text: Fix what slows people down in an existing site or app, from awkward screens to slow pages.

faq.q: How much will my project cost?
faq.a: It depends on what needs to be built. Send me a short description, and I'll ask any missing questions before giving you an estimate.

faq.q: Can you improve an existing website?
faq.a: Yes. Share your current website and what is getting in the way. We can look at the interface, performance, content structure or a specific feature.

faq.q: Do I need a finished specification?
faq.a: No. A short explanation of your business, the problem and what you want to achieve is a useful starting point.
You'll speak with me, Oleksandr. I run O.D. EMPOWER and do the development myself.

items.title: Understand
items.text: You tell me what you need, who will use it and what's not working today.

items.title: Shape
items.text: We agree on what to build first, how to build it and what it will cost.

items.title: Build
items.text: I build it and show you the work as it takes shape, so there's room for feedback.

items.title: Launch
items.text: We test it, put it online and decide what needs support or improvement next.
